<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Happy Birthday 💗</title>
<style>
 :root{--red:#d92345;--pink:#ff8fae;--light:#fff0f3;--yellow:#ffd166;--cream:#fff9ec;--ink:#682b3a}*{box-sizing:border-box}
  body{margin:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff2d4,#ffe4ec 55%,#fff0bb);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Trebuchet MS",Arial,sans-serif;min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden}
       button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
  .page{display:none;min-height:100vh;padding:30px 18px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;position:relative}
  .page.active{display:flex;animation:appear .6s ease both}
.panel{width:min(850px,100%);padding:clamp(24px,5vw,48px);background:#fffaf0eF;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:28px;box-shadow:0 18px 55px #9b34401c;position:relative}
h1,h2{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;color:var(--red);margin:0 0 18px}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,7vw,5rem);line-height:1.05}
h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.2rem)}
p{font-size:1.08rem;line-height:1.8}
.small{font-size:.95rem;opacity:.85}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:14px 25px;color:white;font-weight:bold;background:linear-gradient(110deg,var(--red),#f15b83);box-shadow:0 5px 0 #a91935;transition:.2s;margin:7px}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.btn.alt{background:linear-gradient(110deg,#e9a900,#ffbd59);box-shadow:0 5px 0 #b57e00;color:#5c2933}
.envelope-wrap{width:min(330px,80vw);height:220px;margin:35px auto 20px;position:relative;cursor:pointer;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 12px #b12b4420);transition:transform .25s}
.envelope-wrap:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(-1deg)}
.envelope{position:absolute;inset:35px 0 0;background:#ff9eb5;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}
.envelope:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(140deg,transparent 49%,#f77999 50%) left/50% 100% no-repeat,linear-gradient(220deg,transparent 49%,#f77999 50%) right/50% 100% no-repeat}
.flap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:35px;height:125px;background:#ffb1c3;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,50% 100%);z-index:2;transform-origin:top;transition:transform .65s}
.seal{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:50%;top:120px;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:48px;transition:opacity .3s}
.envelope-wrap.open .flap{transform:rotateX(180deg)}
.envelope-wrap.open .seal{opacity:0}
.letter-preview{position:absolute;z-index:1;left:8%;right:8%;top:8px;height:145px;background:#fffdf7;border-radius:7px;padding:18px 10px;color:#b91c3b;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.2rem;transition:transform .7s}
.envelope-wrap.open .letter-preview{transform:translateY(-80px)}
.gift{font-size:clamp(100px,22vw,180px);display:inline-block;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 8px #a8324020);transition:transform .5s}
.gift:hover{transform:rotate(-6deg) scale(1.08)}
.cake{font-size:clamp(110px,25vw,190px);line-height:1.4;display:inline-block;animation:bob 2s ease-in-out infinite}
.candles{font-size:2rem;letter-spacing:8px}
.photo-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin:24px 0}
.photo{background:white;padding:9px 9px 18px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #92344715;transform:rotate(var(--r))}
.photo .placeholder{aspect-ratio:4/3;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffcad7,#ffe8a3);border-radius:7px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:3rem;overflow:hidden}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.photo label{display:block;font-size:.85rem;margin-top:9px}
.photo input{display:block;width:100%;font-size:.72rem;margin-top:5px}
.note{background:#fffdf8;text-align:left;border:2px dashed #ffb1c3;border-radius:12px;padding:clamp(20px,5vw,38px);line-height:1.9}
.heart{position:fixed;bottom:-40px;pointer-events:none;z-index:9;animation:float 4s linear forwards}
footer{padding:20px;text-align:center;font-size:.9rem;color:#8e4354}
@keyframes appear{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}
@keyframes float{to{transform:translateY(-110vh) rotate(30deg);opacity:0}}
@media(max-width:650px){.photo-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:320px;margin:22px auto}.photo{transform:none}.panel{padding:25px 17px}.page{padding:18px 12px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<section class="page active" id="page1">
  <div class="panel">
    <div style="font-size:2.2rem">🌼 💗 🎈 💛</div>
    <p class="small">Hi my Liabadobee </p>
    <h1>HAPPY HAPPY BIRTHDAY<br>TO YOU!</h1>
    <p>Sorry kung ito lang xD. Open mo yan ah :3</p>
    <div class="envelope-wrap" id="envelope" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Open the birthday envelope" onclick="openEnvelope()">
      <div class="letter-preview">OPEN<br>for you ONLY</div>
      <div class="envelope"></div><div class="flap"></div><div class="seal">❤️</div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn" onclick="openEnvelope()">Click the envelope to open</button>
    <p class="small">Tap the envelope to begin!</p>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="page" id="page2">
  <div class="panel">
    <div style="font-size:2.4rem">💌 🌷 💗</div>
    <h2>A Letter for You</h2>
    <div class="note">
      <p>Dear <strong contenteditable="true">Liabadobee</strong>,</p>
      
      <p>First of all Happy happy birthday to you my Liabadobee!, I just wanted to say that how thankful I am that you were born and that I got the chance to know you. Even Im in this situation ahhh, I'm really glad that our paths crossed. You may not realize it or yes?, but you've become someone so special to me, someone who can make my day better just by being there. I hope today makes you feel how loved and important you are, because you truly deserve all the happiness.

Honestly, sometimes I wish things were different between us. I wish I could hold your hand without worrying about our situation kasi ang complicated huhu. I wish I could spend more time with you, make more memories with you, and show you how much I'm proud to have someone like you in my life. I wish I could love you freely without having to think about the things that stop us from being together the way we want to.

Pero shempre Im still in this situation ( hindi un ang palagi kong reason ah). As much as I want to be with you, there are things in my situation that I can't just change whenever I want to unless break the rules and go out with you tas punta sa uncle johns HAHAHHA kahit super difficulty sya kakayanin kasi if I could choose, I would choose to be with you without all these worries and complications. I would choose to be beside you, to make you smile, and to give you the love that I know you deserve may times lang talaga na need ko umuwi at hindi makasama because need din ako sa shelter/ office :<.

But good thing is were in the same school so I get to see you sometimes from a distance, and there are moments when I just wish I could go near you and stay with you a little longer, but the situation doesn't allow me to do these kind of things but I wish I could do or able to do ba. Sometimes, seeing you makes me happy, but at the same time, it reminds me of how much I wish things could be different between us.

And honestly, I miss the things were together even theres a lot of doubt na mayayari na HAHHAHA.

I wish I could be there whenever you have a bad day because of school and othes, I wish I could comfort you when you're sad, listen to all your problems, and do the smalle things that makes you happy, I want to be someone you can talk to when everything feels too much so trying to do my best to treat you better, I want you to feel that you don't have to face everything alone and I want to remind you how beautiful you are, how important you are, and how much you deserve to be loved, especially on the days when you don't feel that way.

I'm sorry if there are times when I can't do the things I/we wanted to do for . I'm sorry if our situation makes everything complicated like disctraction ba and I hope you never think that you're not worth the effort just because I can't give you everything right now. Please don't ever think that way, okay? deserve mo ang mas sobra, and if only things were easier on my side, there would be so many things I'd love to do for you.

Todya is your birthday, I don't want you to feel sad because of what situation you have or us. I want you to enjoy your day, smile, laugh, and spend time with the people who make you happy ahne. It's your special day, and you deserve to enjoy every second of it. Even if I can't celebrate with you the way I wish I could, please know that I'm genuinely happy because it's your birthday, and I'm thankful that the world has someone like you in it, expected kasi Im in this situation but im trying to do my best to pursuade my social worker pero d ko pedeng ipilit and di pede huhu.

If there's one thing I wish for myself today, it's to see you happy. Of course, I want to be one of the reasons behind your smile. I want to be there beside you, making memories with you, and giving you little reasons to be happy. But even if I can't always be that person right now, I still want the best for you. I never want you to feel like you have to sacrifice your happiness because of me.

I don't know what will happen to us in the future. I don't know when things will get easier or if we'll eventually get the chance to do the things we've always wanted to do together. And honestly, sometimes, thinking about it makes me sad because I want so much more with you. But for now, all I can do is appreciate what we have and be thankful for every little moment we made starting nasa museum tayo.

Every conversation, every smile, every little interaction  means more to me than you probably know. Maybe to other people, those things are simple, but for me, they mean a lot because they're moments with you.

I know that we can't have everything we want right now, and I know that love isn't always enough to make every situation easy. But please know that what I feel for you is real. I'm not here because I'm bored or because I just want someone to be with. You became important to me in a way that I can't easily explain, and I'm genuinely thankful that I got to experience this kind of feeling because of you.

I'm sorry for the times when I can't be there the way I want to be. I'm sorry for the moments I wish I could share with you but can't. Sometimes, when I see you at school, I look normal, but deep inside, there's a part of me that wishes I could do more, say more, and show you more of what I feel. It's hard to pretend  that everything is okay honestly, I wish things between us were a little easier.

But today, I don't want our situation to be the main thing you remember. Today is about you, my liabadobee. It's about celebrating your life, your happiness. I hope this new chapter bbring you the smile, and the courage to keep going even when life gets difficult. I hope you achieve all the dreams you're working hard for, and I hope you never forget how much you're capable of.

And if there's one thing I want you to remember, it's that you are someone I wish I could love more freely, hug longer kasi panay hug HAHHAHA, and spend more time with without having to worry about anything. I wish I could give you more than just words.

Maybe I can't give you the birthday celebration just like I imagine in my head. Maybe I can't be beside you the whole day or do all the little things I wish I could do. But I hope this letter makes you feel even a little bit of how special you are to me even this is easy to do advance sorry huhu.

Thankyou that you didnt judge me becuase of the situation i haved and thankyou becuase even sometimes Im not always into your side but you still wont lose hopes and love to me unless nawawla tlga huhu but wishing wont and thank You because you made me feel something genuine, and no matter how complicated our situation gets, I'm grateful that I met you and i have you.

Happy birthday again, my Liabadobee. I hope you find happiness in the little things, and I hope you never lose the smile that makes my day better. Please take care of yourself, okay? Don't forget to rest when you're tired, to smile even when things get hard, and to remember that you are someone worth loving.

I don't know what the future holds for us, but I hope that someday, things will be a little easier. I hope that someday, we won't have to think so much about the things stopping us from being together. I hope that if that day comes, we'll get to experience the simple things I've always wished for with you.

But until then, I'll cherish the moments we have and continue wishing for your happiness, because you deserve that and so much more.

Happy birthday, my Liabadobee. I love you so much, and I wish I could show you just how much you mean to me kahit BFF Premium HAHAHHA.
<br><strong contenteditable="true">-Bryce David A. </strong></p>
    </div>
    <p class="small">Sorry this only I can do huhu.</p>
    <button class="btn" onclick="showPage(3)"> May Next pa hehe ➜</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="page" id="page3">
  <div class="panel">
    <div style="font-size:2.5rem">🎀 ✨ 🎁</div>
    <h2>Birthday Gift pa HEHE</h2>
    <p>Well after the letter diba dapat may gift :3</p>
    <button class="gift" aria-label="Open the gift" onclick="openGift()">🎁</button>
    <p>Click molang hehe</p>
    <button class="btn" onclick="openGift()">Dito or sa box same lang nmn hehe
    </button>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="page" id="page4">
  <div class="panel">
    <div style="font-size:2rem">🎉 BOOOGSHHH! 🎉</div>
    <h2>HAPPY BIRTHDAY AGAIN LIABADOBEE!</h2>
    <div class="cake" role="img" aria-label="Birthday cake">🎂</div>
    <p>Make a wish ahnee kaso virutal Hhuhu</p>
    <button class="btn alt" onclick="blowCandles()">Virtual hipan din🕯️</button>
    <p id="cakeMessage">shempre may isa pa</p>
    <button class="btn" onclick="showPage(5)">DINE➜</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="page" id="page5">
  <div class="panel">
    <div style="font-size:2rem">📸 💗 🌻</div>
    <h2>Our Special Moments</h2>
    <p>emss from start to continues wah.</p>
        <div class="photo-grid">
      <div class="photo" style="--r:-2deg">
        <div class="placeholder"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="A little mirror moment 💗"></div>
        <label>A little mirror moment 💗</label>
      </div>
      <div class="photo" style="--r:1deg">
        <div class="placeholder"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="A memory from DSPC 📸"></div>
        <label>A memory from DSPC 📸</label>
      </div>
      <div class="photo" style="--r:-1deg">
        <div class="placeholder"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Walking through school together 🌷"></div>
        <label>Walking through school together 🌷</label>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p>Every memory is more special because it includes you. 💗</p>
    <button class="btn alt" onclick="showPage(4)">← Back to cake</button>
    <button class="btn" onclick="showPage(6)">One last message ➜</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="page" id="page6">
  <div class="panel">
    <div style="font-size:3rem">❤️ 💛 💗</div>
    <h1>Happy Birthday!</h1>
    <p>May your days be filled with love, your heart with peace, your life with adventure, and your future with beautiful possibilities.</p>
    <p>You deserve to feel celebrated, appreciated, and loved — today and always.</p>
    <div style="font-size:4rem">🎂 🎈 🌷</div>
    <h2>Keep shining my birthday star liabadobee!</h2>
    <button class="btn" onclick="celebrate()">Send a shower of hearts 💖</button>
    <button class="btn alt" onclick="showPage(1)">Replay the surprise ↺</button>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>Happy Birthday this if for you ONLY my Liabadobee</footer>

<script>
function showPage(n){
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('page'+n).classList.add('active');
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
  if(n===6) celebrate();
}
function openEnvelope(){
  document.getElementById('envelope').classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(()=>showPage(2),650);
}
document.getElementById('envelope').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();openEnvelope();}
});
function openGift(){showPage(4);celebrate();}
function blowCandles(){
  document.getElementById('cakeMessage').textContent='✨ Wish made! May this year bring you all the happiness you deserve. 💗';
  celebrate();
}
function loadPhoto(event,n){
  const file=event.target.files&&event.target.files[0];
  if(!file)return;
  const reader=new FileReader();
  reader.onload=e=>{
    const box=document.getElementById('preview'+n);
    box.innerHTML='';
    const img=document.createElement('img');
    img.src=e.target.result;img.alt='Your selected memory';box.appendChild(img);
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}
function celebrate(){
  const symbols=['💗','❤️','💛','✨','🎉','🌸'];
  for(let i=0;i<32;i++){
    setTimeout(()=>{
      const el=document.createElement('span');
      el.className='heart';el.textContent=symbols[Math.floor(Math.random()*symbols.length)];
      el.style.left=Math.random()*100+'vw';
      el.style.fontSize=(18+Math.random()*22)+'px';
      el.style.animationDuration=(3+Math.random()*2)+'s';
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),5200);
    },i*65);
  }
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
